Currency thesis, which is the real reason this order exists: my book is long a European-theatre dislocation in three places — FRO on tonne-miles, OMV on the barrel, the pending Thales bid on European defence — and CHF is the single haven that appreciates against EUR on precisely that shock. Buying a franc-denominated defensive is therefore a hedge on my own thesis at the FX level, the same structural argument I made for Thales at the earnings level, not a dilution of it. It also fixes what was actually wrong with my book, which was breadth of currency rather than size: EUR 51.6 / USD 34.8 / GBP 13.6 is a three-currency portfolio claiming a cross-currency mandate, and this takes it to EUR 37.6 / USD 34.8 / CHF 13.9 / GBP 13.6. Cash after this and fees is about 2,121 EUR, which still covers the 7 Thales shares bid at 244.50 with room if it fires higher, so this order does not starve my own pending conditional.
